data: Mock simulated data on a physical Xiaomi Pad 5 (Android 13); not hardware acceptance or a live website feed

device.displayNote: Real tablet framebuffer of the Mock build only; this is not a claim of real machine behavior.

appBuild.versionEvidence: Mock build invoked with -PhoyiVersionCode=164 -PhoyiVersionName=0.2.0-mock.164; package, version, APK hash and signer were read back locally after build and install.
appBuild.identityNotice: Same debug signing identity as the previously installed Mock. adb install -r succeeded over versionCode 164 without uninstall or clear-data. This is not a public release or a reproducible-build claim.

sourceVerification.method: Local git worktree comparison: App/application-source paths diffed against e5cd67ac (empty), then the Mock APK was built, hashed, verified with apksigner and installed on the tablet.
sourceVerification.scope: Application-source equivalence and local APK identity only; not a reproducible build, CI run, public-release certification, or hardware acceptance.

captureSession.themeSequence: Dark screenshots were captured first; the theme was switched to light for the light screenshots, then restored to dark.
captureSession.mockExtraction: One simulated extraction was started and stopped in Mock to capture the live chart. Mock mode has no BLE connection and no real machine command was sent.
captureSession.cleanup: Mock was force-stopped and the real app was brought back to the foreground. Mock data was not cleared.
